dedupe_keys.name: an electronic toll collection gateway ble rssi dataset for localization of smartphones in vehicular scenarios

description: An electronic toll collection gateway BLE RSSI dataset for localization of smartphones in vehicular scenarios is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Alejandro Gil-Martínez et al. This paper presents a dataset based on Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and the use of smartphones for vehicle localization and tracking. An antenna system formed by eight directive panel antennas forming a crossed array is mounted on an electronic toll collection (ETC) gateway, at a height of 4.75 m, facing downwards illuminating a two-lane road. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: Excel, MATLAB, Image. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
